retained_native_dma_proof.qualification_note: Reuse existing own-source native channel/PAC/terminal contract and its documented SDK conflicts. Old inventory-only SPI labels describe that ledger historical scope; this independent ledger qualifies only these six paired SPI endpoints. UART RC/ORE RX semantics remain unresolved and no UART RX/combined surface is qualified.

implementation_requirements: Normative hardware facts above require independent review of their actual runtime use; this ledger does not establish software acceptance.

Validate both exclusive static SRAM stages and own both DMA channels. Preserve sequential admission: failure of second admission consumes the first. Generic CW32L012 has no memory/package metadata and must reject safe staging with MissingMemoryMetadata.

Settle prior paired activity before staging access. Reject dirty admission without reset. Restore WIDTH7 only while disabled and idle. Close requests and enter InFlight before either DMA enable; arm RX before TX, then open DMARX before DMATX. This RX-first sequence is conservative engineering, not a vendor recipe.
Enable SPI error notification during DMA so a stalled endpoint still fails. Error ISR must not read DR, clear RXNE, flush, disable as a fake drain, or expose RX CPU access.

Require both clean DMA terminals, then close requests, observe error-free TXE1/BUSY0, and fence/retire both before success, RX CPU access or stage reuse. No single TC, EN0, zero remaining count, closed gate, reset or stop proves all paired memory traffic retired.
BUSY has no interrupt. Preserve bounded observation/cooperative wake tail without a finite-completion or low-power claim. TXE alone does not permit CS release.

Any SPI/DMA error or partial launch quarantines the whole pair. Cancellation or forget retains the current chunk and pending settlement. Caller keeps original GPIO CS asserted until successful flush. Unresolved Drop retains SPI, pins, stages, pair and clocks.

Complete SPI23 handler visits PIO2, DMA2, PIO3 and DMA3. Inactive states return before MMIO. Both DMA constructors require complete associated binding. Preserve PIO2/DMA3, DMA2/PIO3 and DMA2/DMA3 coexistence without sibling DR/flag/reset/gate/shared-vector interference.
Per-channel DMA handlers preserve sibling flags and shared bank ownership. No channel is recycled after clean Drop; four channels allow at most two permanently admitted pairs.

Preserve L012 MISO pull-down rejection, GPIO bank handover obligations, existing borrowed PIO and compiler-derived Send/Sync. No UART RX/combined constructor, public raw endpoint, circular/streaming, slave/simplex/half-duplex, wider async frame, early abort/recovery/re-admission, RF/electrical/low-power or hardware claim.
